apps.versionDescription: Spotify Core v0.60.13 (Modified by Ares) — Built on Spotify 9.1.90: Fixed an immediate startup crash in EeveePremiumForce caused by ARC retaining non-NSObject runtime classes during objc_getClassList scanning, added the Block rating prompts toggle in Privacy (enabled by default), and kept the reworked Premium, ads & privacy page (True Shuffle, Hide upsells, Clean shared links, Block telemetry).
apps.localizedDescription: Spotify Core (Modified by Ares) built on Spotify 9.1.90: 20 custom app icons in Appearance -> App icon (iOS 16.1+ & iOS 26+), curated first-install defaults, Liquid Glass UI (iOS 26+) & Legacy UI (iOS 16.1+), built-in Spotify Premium Lifetime & ad-blocking, True Shuffle, Clean shared links, Block rating prompts, synced lyrics & Sing mode, offline downloads, Audio DSP, AutoMix, Live Activity, and Open in Spotify Core Safari extension.
